# Percona Experience - Enterprise Database Solutions

> > Enterprise-grade open source database solutions and operators for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Valkey on Kubernetes.

Percona Experience showcases Percona's database products, operators, consulting services, and technical guides. The site focuses on helping organizations run production databases without vendor lock-in, featuring alternatives to EDB and Crunchy Data for PostgreSQL, enterprise MongoDB distributions, and support for both Redis and Valkey migrations.

## Key Topics

- Percona Operators for Kubernetes
- PostgreSQL enterprise solutions
- MongoDB alternatives
- Redis and Valkey migration
- MySQL database management
- Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM)
- Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL
- Open source databases
- Vendor lock-in avoidance
- Database security and compliance
- pg_stat_statements
- Enterprise database support
- Cost optimization
- GDPR, SOX, PCI DSS, HIPAA compliance

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Percona Operators for Kubernetes Databases](https://experience.percona.com): Homepage: Percona Operators for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB on Kubernetes
- [Percona for PostgreSQL](https://experience.percona.com/postgresql/home): Percona for PostgreSQL: Open source enterprise PostgreSQL distribution
- [Enterprise-Grade PostgreSQL Without Trade-Offs](https://experience.percona.com/postgresql/hub): PostgreSQL hub: Alternative to EDB & Crunchy Data without vendor lock-in
- [Percona MongoDB Alternative](https://experience.percona.com/mongodb/percona-mongodb-alternative): MongoDB alternative: Percona Server for MongoDB without vendor lock-in
- [Redis and Valkey Support](https://experience.percona.com/valkey-redis/percona-has-you-covered): Redis vs Valkey comparison: Support for both in-memory databases
- [Percona Support and Services for Redis and Valkey](https://experience.percona.com/valkey-redis/support-and-services): Enterprise support & services for Redis and Valkey deployments

## Professional Services

- [Percona Consulting](https://experience.percona.com/postgresql/consulting): Custom database consulting for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Valkey
- [Case Study - Türk Telekom](https://experience.percona.com/case-study/turks-teleco): Case study: Türk Telekom PostgreSQL migration with Percona Distribution

## PostgreSQL Documentation & Guides

- [PostgreSQL Security Solution Brief](https://experience.percona.com/postgresql/postgre-sql-security-solution-brief): PostgreSQL security: GDPR, SOX, PCI DSS, HIPAA compliance with TDE
- [Chapter 2: pg_stat_statements](https://experience.percona.com/postgresql/how-postgresql-elevates-your-business/chapter-2-pgstatstatements): Guide: Using pg_stat_statements for PostgreSQL query performance insights
- [Chapter 3: pgAdmin](https://experience.percona.com/postgresql/how-postgresql-elevates-your-business/chapter-3-pgadmin): Guide: pgAdmin for PostgreSQL database management and DBA workflows
